name: Prefect
description: The Prefect orchestration server and UI: Python flows report their runs, logs and schedules to it, and workers you run elsewhere pick up the deployments it schedules. One container on SQLite, kept on the data volume.

access.note: Prefect server has no accounts of its own: anyone who can open the address can see every flow run and schedule work for your workers. Keep it behind the deployment's password protection; Prefect clients send the same basic credentials if PREFECT_API_AUTH_STRING is set to user:password on their side.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address the UI and the API are reached at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The UI and the REST API flows and workers talk to

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database of flows, runs, logs and schedules

update.notes: Prefect migrates its database on start; take a backup before moving to a newer minor release.
